task.title: Replace feedback/documentation with decision build orchestration
task.summary: Introduce the vNext decision_build path as a clean replacement for routine feedback/documentation compiler code, with direct decision-to-planning handoff and no backwards-compatibility wrappers in package source.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki uses decision_build as the clean semantic intent-to-knowledge handoff and planning consumes decision_build directly.
acceptance: Decision build kind/schema is represented in domain/application/adapters as the semantic build path.
Decision orchestration supports proposal and accepted modes with no canonical writes before approval.
Accepted decision artifacts record approved rows, row-to-KB mappings, product/system propagation direction, assumptions, risks, and downstream planning questions.
Planning builds consume source_decision_build directly; routine source_documentation_build requirements are removed from package source.
Feedback/documentation compiler loops are removed from primary package source/tests rather than kept as compatibility wrappers.
non_goals: Do not implement graph diagram-ref audits or gate fast paths in this task.
Do not consolidate all public workflow tools in this task.
Do not implement TASK-002 diagram migration beyond decision_build refs needed by this task.
verification: Run typecheck and focused build/tool smoke tests.
Validate decision-build traceability with a new or updated smoke test.
Run CodeWiki alignment and stale-reference audits.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

summary: Add CodeWiki-owned Pi compaction soft context refresh seeded by resume-context packets, so same-terminal context cleanup can happen automatically at loop boundaries or high context usage without relying on VCC, generic chat compaction, or user-run fresh-session commands.
checks_run: codewiki_audit profiles=file-structure,package,generated-parity,security,alignment (fails only pre-existing graph health 6 errors)

evidence: Focused smoke test covers pure compaction trigger/pending-request helpers without requiring live Pi TUI session replacement.
Existing package smoke verifies adapter registration surfaces and package loadability.
Prompt asset smoke verifies CodeWiki-owned compaction guidance in shipped skills/prompts.
tester.boundary: derive tests or test-design evidence before code changes where practical

evidence: Added src/adapters/pi/compaction.ts with CodeWiki compaction installer, pending boundary request API, threshold trigger guard, and custom session_before_compact summary injection.
Updated src/adapters/pi/index.ts to install compaction hooks and request soft refresh after build, validation, close, or cancel boundaries.
Updated resume-context tool guidance, README, skills, and system KB to make CodeWiki-owned compaction the normal soft refresh path and /wiki-resume --new a hard replacement-session path.
notes: Pi SDK research showed tool contexts cannot call ctx.newSession and pi.sendUserMessage does not execute slash commands because prompt expansion is disabled; compaction is the viable same-terminal automated context cleanup mechanism.
Compaction is intentionally triggered from turn_end, not inside tool execute, to avoid the prior ctx.compact hazard where tool results could be hidden.
builder.boundary: change code until tests, roadmap acceptance, and required checks pass

test_design_evidence: Focused smoke test covers pure compaction trigger/pending-request helpers without requiring live Pi TUI session replacement.
Existing package smoke verifies adapter registration surfaces and package loadability.
Prompt asset smoke verifies CodeWiki-owned compaction guidance in shipped skills/prompts.
code_change_evidence: Added src/adapters/pi/compaction.ts with CodeWiki compaction installer, pending boundary request API, threshold trigger guard, and custom session_before_compact summary injection.
Updated src/adapters/pi/index.ts to install compaction hooks and request soft refresh after build, validation, close, or cancel boundaries.
Updated resume-context tool guidance, README, skills, and system KB to make CodeWiki-owned compaction the normal soft refresh path and /wiki-resume --new a hard replacement-session path.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: CodeWiki can clean context in same terminal without starting a new Pi session.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/compaction.ts installs session_before_compact and turn_end hooks; turn_end triggers ctx.compact only after visible tool results, and session_before_compact injects a regenerated CodeWiki resume packet.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Loop boundaries can request context cleanup at the same semantic points previously considered for new sessions.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/index.ts requests CodeWiki context refresh after codewiki_build, codewiki_validation, and task close/cancel tool calls; refresh executes at safe turn_end.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Resume packet remains source of truth and avoids chat-history memory.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/compaction.ts builds compaction summaries with buildCodewikiResumeContext; docs and skills now distinguish CodeWiki-owned compaction from generic Pi compaction/VCC recovery.

tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs covers threshold trigger logic, pending boundary requests, and boundary instruction formatting; package/prompt smoke asserts adapter installation and guidance.

closure_brief.user_intent: Replace normal fresh-session/manual context-cleanup flow with CodeWiki-owned same-terminal compaction that injects resume-context packets and can trigger at loop boundaries or high context usage.
implemented_changes: Added CodeWiki-owned Pi compaction soft refresh hooks.
Queued soft refresh requests from build, validation, and task close/cancel tool boundaries.
Updated docs/skills/KB to distinguish CodeWiki-owned compaction from generic Pi compaction/VCC recovery.
Added focused compaction smoke test and wired it into npm test:smoke.
acceptance_evidence: CodeWiki audit passes file-structure/package/generated-parity/security and fails only pre-existing alignment graph-health errors
remaining_risks: Requires /reload for the active Pi process to use new compaction hooks.
Pre-existing CodeWiki alignment graph health errors remain.

risks: Live Pi extension must be reloaded before new compaction hooks are active in the running terminal.
Alignment audit still reports pre-existing graph health errors from historical planning-build metadata; file-structure, package, generated-parity, and security pass.
